heading: Build Fire Drill as a controls gate. The prizes broke the tie, and no new idea beat it.
text: The agents left Netting House and Fire Drill almost level. Both compete for Hyphenate's Autonomous Systems for Finance track ($8K / $5K / $3K), so the rest decided it: Fire Drill fits more posted prizes where sponsor tech does real work (Cartesia, Armadin, Capital One Nessie, Elastic, CRS Identity / Fraud), its core loop runs on text while we are two people until Saturday evening, and the judge takes part. Then 40 new ideas were generated to beat it, and the best six were scored by the same agents. None beat Fire Drill on its own. The only candidate above it is Fire Drill inside a controls gate the judge can write rules for, and Netting House fell behind two new ideas.

heading: What to build: one controls gate, two judge moments
text: Pitch: your accountant's controls, run like unit tests before the money moves, starting with the one that stops payment-redirect fraud. Control one is Fire Drill: no payment to bank details that first appeared in untrusted text, and a refusal phones the vendor on the number of record (the judge's phone). Moment two: the judge writes a control in their own words, and it goes live only after a read-back, blind examples and one clarifying question. Then the judge tries to get a payment past it on Capital One Nessie. Cut the hole finder. Build the gate and the hand-written rules Friday night, the rule compiler and benchmark Saturday, and the voice callback when the third teammate arrives. Name Hamming, Trustpair (now Basware), Eftsure and KnowBe4 first, and frame it for Hyphenate as continuous controls testing.

heading: Tracks to enter
text: Hyphenate as the primary track, then Cartesia and Armadin. Use Capital One Nessie as the payment rail. Add Anthropic if it posts a prize at opening, and Creao's Best AI-First Disruptor if any project can enter. Leave every other sponsor off the pitch.

heading: If Hyphenate's track text tips it: Netting House or Original Bill
text: Switch at opening only if Hyphenate's full track text points away from controls. If it stresses treasury, cash or settlement, build Netting House: two of the three agents still prefer it, but it is the most fragile demo for two people. If it stresses receivables, financing or fraud, build Original Bill: one signed original per receivable, so the debtor pays only the current holder. It has the best why-now in the pool (the First Brands double-pledging charges), and its weak points are thin AI and a debtor with no reason to join.

heading: What to stop discussing
text: Two-Face, reshaped, only if we chase Visa and Apify instead of Hyphenate. Every glasses and Trainium idea, Jailbreak Booth, Save States, Cal Hacks Futures and The Pit sit at the bottom on every lens. So do Close Raid, Backlog Tower Defense and Zero-Trust Base Defense. Vault Heist only comes back if SpacetimeDB and Supercell post real prizes at opening: Tensor Trust is already a multiplayer vault game.
